name: slabline
description: Look up current Slabline market values for graded sports and TCG trading cards across PSA, BGS, SGC, and CGC.

interface.longDescription: Find current Slabline market values for graded sports and TCG trading cards across PSA, BGS, SGC, and CGC. View graded value, raw/loose value, and the across-grades total when available, with a link to the Slabline card page. The hosted MCP server provides search and valuation tools and a visual card-tile widget.
defaultPrompt: Find the current Slabline value of my graded trading card.
Compare Slabline values for the same card across grades.
